cd /home/runner/workspace/ai-agent
node - <<'NODE'
const fs=require('node:fs'), path=require('node:path');
const root='backend/extension/3D_viewer.js';
const code=Buffer.from('','base64').toString('utf8');
const test=Buffer.from('','base64').toString('utf8');
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(root),{recursive:true});
if(fs.existsSync(root) && !fs.readFileSync(root,'utf8').includes('Frontend3DViewer')) throw Error('Unexpected file at '+root);
fs.writeFileSync(root,code);
fs.writeFileSync('backend/extension/3D_viewer.test.js',test);
const htmlPath='frontend/index.html';
let html=fs.readFileSync(htmlPath,'utf8');
html=html.replace(/\s*<script src="\/extension\/browser\/3D_viewer\.js" defer><\/script>/g,'');
if(!html.includes('src="/extension/3D_viewer.js"')) {
  if(!html.includes('</body>')) throw Error('No HTML body closing tag');
  html=html.replace('</body>','  <script src="/extension/3D_viewer.js" defer></script>\n</body>');
}
fs.writeFileSync(htmlPath,html);
const shellPath='frontend/shell-float.js';
let shell=fs.readFileSync(shellPath,'utf8');
const original='if (!panel || panel === root || !running) return;';
if(shell.includes(original)) shell=shell.replace(original,'if (!panel || panel === root || !running || window.Frontend3DViewer) return;');
fs.writeFileSync(shellPath,shell);
const petPath='backend/extension/pet/limbo/pet.js';
let pet=fs.readFileSync(petPath,'utf8');
if(!pet.includes('isAIControlActive:')) {
  const signature='setAIControlActive, moveTo });';
  if(!pet.includes(signature)) throw Error('Pet export signature changed');
  pet=pet.replace(signature,'setAIControlActive, moveTo, isAIControlActive: () => aiControlActive });');
  fs.writeFileSync(petPath,pet);
}
const old='backend/extension/browser/3D_viewer.js';
if(fs.existsSync(old) && fs.readFileSync(old,'utf8').includes('Browser 3D window stack')) fs.unlinkSync(old);
console.log('3D_WORKSPACE_V2_PATCH_OK',JSON.stringify({module:root,html:html.includes('src="/extension/3D_viewer.js"'),pet:pet.includes('isAIControlActive:'),shell:shell.includes('window.Frontend3DViewer')}));
NODE
node --check backend/extension/3D_viewer.js
node --test backend/extension/3D_viewer.test.js
